verdict.rationale: Time-zone handling for invitees is a fair axis for a scheduling product, but no evidence item covers it. Nothing mentions automatic detection of the invitee's time zone, displaying slots in local time, or DST handling. The slot and schedule API docs describe availability queries only, with no time-zone behavior.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, invitees always see slots in their own time zone — detection, display, and DST handling are automatic
